name: arcsync-mcp
description: Architecture graphs from Terraform, CDK, CloudFormation, Pulumi and ARM, for coding agents
long_description:
Gives Claude the architecture graph ArcSync parsed from your infrastructure-as-code: resources and the IAM, network and event relationships between them. Claude can also write, validate and publish its own ArcSync diagrams.

The first tool call returns a link to connect your ArcSync account in the browser. To use a credential you created in Settings instead, fill in both fields below.

client_id.title: Client ID (optional)
client_id.description: Leave empty to connect in the browser. Otherwise, an MCP credential's client ID (arc_…) from arcsync.dev Settings.

client_secret.title: Client secret (optional)
client_secret.description: The secret paired with the client ID (arcsec_…). Leave empty to connect in the browser.

tools.name: list_diagrams
tools.description: List the diagrams in your workspace, filtered by repository, branch or path

tools.name: get_diagram
tools.description: Get one diagram as Mermaid or JSON, with a link to the interactive canvas

tools.name: describe_resource
tools.description: Describe one resource and every relationship in and out of it

tools.name: get_delta
tools.description: Show what a pull request or a re-parse changes in the architecture

tools.name: start_parse
tools.description: Parse a GitHub repository into a new diagram

tools.name: get_parse_status
tools.description: Report the progress of a parse started with start_parse

tools.name: validate_diagram
tools.description: Check a diagram written in ArcSync syntax, locally

tools.name: push_diagram
tools.description: Store a validated diagram and return its canvas and embed links

tools.name: get_diagram_source
tools.description: Return the source of a pushed diagram, to edit it

tools.name: list_icons
tools.description: List the icon ids a written diagram can use
